extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, appellate attorneys, parties in PTAB post-grant review proceedings, and judges
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Circuit disposition addressing mootness of an appeal from a PTAB final written decision in light of a companion appeal that invalidated the same patent claims. The page explains that an invalidity determination in a companion proceeding renders related appeals moot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written description and enablement (patent validity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims held invalid for "lack of adequate written description and enablement."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The companion Federal Circuit opinion held the same claims of the '039 patent invalid for lack of adequate written description and enablement (cited at slip op. 12, 18). A finding that a specification fails to provide an adequate written description or enable a claimed invention is a ground for invalidating the claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mootness when invalidity determination issued in a companion case
rubrics_metrics.description: An "invalidity determination renders moot 'all pending or co-pending actions'."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a court invalidates the patent in a companion appeal, that invalidity determination typically renders related pending or co-pending actions moot. The opinion cites XY, LLC v. Trans Ova Genetics, 890 F.3d 1282, 1294 (Fed. Cir. 2018), and notes the court may decline to reach the merits of companion proceedings when claims are held invalid (see also Biogen Int’l GMBH v. Mylan Pharms. Inc., 18 F.4th 1333, 1346 (Fed. Cir. 2021)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Concession of mootness by appellant disposes of the appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: "At oral argument, Seagen conceded that a determination of invalidity for the '039 patent in the companion case renders the instant appeal moot."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A party's concession at oral argument that a companion decision would render its appeal moot supports dismissal of the appeal. The court relied on Seagen's concession and dismissed the appeal as moot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appealability of PTAB final written decisions in PGR
rubrics_metrics.description: This is "Appeal from the United States Patent and Trademark Office, Patent Trial and Appeal Board . . . in No. PGR2021-00030."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final written decisions by the PTAB in post-grant review proceedings are subject to appeal to the Federal Circuit; however, appellate review may be rendered unnecessary if the patent is invalidated in a companion proceeding or other controlling action.
